lower.name: Clamshell x15/side (LEFT first)
lower.cue: On your side, knees bent 90, short band above the knees, feet together. Open the top knee without rolling the hips back. Do the LEFT side first and give it one extra set. This switches on the glute that goes quiet.

lower.name: Frog Pump x20
lower.cue: On your back, heels together, knees wide, feet close to your butt. Drive through the heels and squeeze the glutes hard. This position forces the glutes to lead instead of the hamstrings.

lower.name: Deep Squat Hold x30s
lower.cue: Sit into a deep squat, hold a rack or post for balance, heels down, knees pushed out. Use the stance width that lets you sit comfortably. Relax and breathe.

lower.name: Wall Ankle Rocker x5/side
lower.cue: Toes a few inches from the wall, heel stays DOWN, drive the knee forward over the second toe toward the wall.

upper.name: Band Pull-Apart x15
upper.cue: Band at chest height, arms straight, pull it apart to your chest and squeeze the shoulder blades. Wakes up the upper back.

upper.name: Wall Slides x10
upper.cue: Back to the wall, arms in a goal-post, slide them up keeping wrists and elbows on the wall. Opens the shoulders for pressing and the swim catch.

upper.name: Band External Rotation x15/side
upper.cue: Elbow pinned to your side and bent 90 degrees, band across your body, rotate the forearm out without letting the elbow drift off your ribs. Small movement. This is cuff work for a shoulder that swims four times a week: common practice, no trial behind it, and it is here rather than in the log because there is no honest way to progress it.

upper.name: Arm Circles + Thoracic Rotation x8/side
upper.cue: Big slow arm circles, then on all fours rotate one arm up to the ceiling, following your hand with your eyes.
